paper_title: How to Generate Popular Post Headlines on Social Media
caption: The average likes of headlines from different season groups
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the average number of likes received by social media headlines categorized by their most similar group of posts. The horizontal axis, labeled “Most similar group of posts,” displays five distinct categories: (0,90], (90,180], (180,270], (270,360], and (360,450). The vertical axis, titled “Avg. Like #”, ranges from approximately 400 to 600 and uses a linear scale, with tick intervals of 50.  Each bar represents the average number of likes for a particular group of posts, with the height of each bar indicating the average value. The tallest bar, corresponding to the (360,450) group, reaches a height of approximately 580. The shortest bar, associated with the (0,90] group, reaches a height of approximately 460. Error bars, colored in gray, extend upwards and downwards from the tops of each bar, indicating the variability in the average like counts within each group. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their consistent height representation.
